main_subject.wardrobe: A dark indigo denim trucker jacket buttoned over a plain black tee, matching high-waisted wide-leg carpenter jeans, and plain black leather sneakers.
main_subject.pose_and_expression: Full-body portrait leaning lightly against a weathered metal pole, arms folded comfortably.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 9:16 vertical Portra-inspired 35mm fashion photograph of an adult woman with long wavy brown hair and a neutral sideways gaze. She wears a buttoned dark-indigo denim trucker jacket over a plain black tee, matching high-waisted wide-leg carpenter jeans, and plain black leather sneakers. Frame her full body at eye level, leaning lightly against a weathered metal pole with arms folded comfortably. Place her at a muted cobblestone urban corner with a softly blurred unbranded olive vintage sedan behind her. Use soft overcast daylight, natural shadow detail, fine grain, textured denim, natural skin, realistic hands, and restrained dynamic range. No midriff exposure, stickers, vehicle badge, plate, logo, readable sign, text, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, celebrity likeness, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, midriff, lingerie, HDR, logo, vehicle badge, license plate, readable text, watermark, distorted hands, AI artifacts
